rationale.a: Accessibility applies to specific spaces; typical bedrooms are not required to be wheelchair-accessible unless specified.
rationale.b: While PD 1096 does establish minimum bedroom dimensions (though smaller than practice standard); this dimension would comply with code but not practice.

rationale.correct: While PD 1096 requires light/ventilation but no area minimum, standard design practice allocates 120 SF for secondary bedrooms to accommodate a bed, dresser, desk/chair, and comfortable circulation without forced layout. Code minimum and design standard are distinct; this is a common ALE mistake.
